# The salvage — standing reference

*Generated by `pnpm reference` from `data/world/salvage-pack.json` and `sim/road-decks` — do not edit by hand. Phase two's prescribed start (ADR-126): the ten legends (five carried ministers, five power guardians), one free pick per colour (any shop tier including R, never prizeOnly; a card counts for any colour it carries), this PACK (ten per colour at tier 1–2, five colourless; one copy of each), a purse (`salvagePurse`), no manalinks. The player chooses two colours and the editor opens on the assembled first deck (each colour's ten minus its two highest mana values, the picks in the pair, colourless artifacts to eighteen nonland cards, basics to thirty by pips — a credible twelve-land start, not a build). The archetype anchors are deliberately absent: shop finds let a player choose a plan in the flood.*

The pack validates against the pool (every id known; mono-colour at tier 1–2; the colourless five carry no colour).

## The salvage yardsticks (sim/road-decks)

The flood's floor for the sim: the pack's two colours plus two duals as the picks, twelve lands, 12 life, journeyman, no basics in play, no legends. `pnpm mage-sweep --part 10 --phase 2` reads every tier-2/3 mage against both.
